Two printed tables have no measured region: Table 16 on p20 and Table 18 on p22. Both print their caption and their body as plain text with three horizontal rules 286 pt and 273 pt wide, and `rule_table_regions` only groups rules that reach half the page width (306 pt on this 612 pt page), while the standalone rules are thinner than MIN_SIDE_PT and are dropped: so the two tables are measured nowhere and no bbox is invented here. Table numbering is 2, 4-13, 14, 14, 16, 17, 18: Table 1 and Table 3 are never printed and 15 is skipped, and the number 14 is used twice, once for the host-country table on p18 and once for the notation grid on p19.
